data.name: Ifrah
data.gender_notes: Ifrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ifrah', meaning 'growth'. This name is often given to baby girls to symbolize their growth and development. The name Ifrah carries the meaning “Growth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ifrah usually hope their child will grow to embody growth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual growth and development of a person.
data.etymology: Ifrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Growth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ifrah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
